_channelsComment: ROAD TO THE FIRST 1,000 REAL HUMANS mission (2026-08-22) Phase 3 finding: bluesky and mastodon were marked enabled but have never had real credentials in Vercel production (confirmed via `vercel env ls` -- no SOCIAL_BLUESKY_*/SOCIAL_MASTODON_* vars exist at all) -- every real publish attempt on both channels has failed with 'missing env' since launch, generating content variants that could never actually distribute. Disabled here until the owner supplies real credentials; re-enable by flipping these back to true once SOCIAL_BLUESKY_HANDLE/SOCIAL_BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD or SOCIAL_MASTODON_BASE_URL/SOCIAL_MASTODON_ACCESS_TOKEN are actually set in Vercel. facebook and linkedin are both confirmed working with real verified posts.

cadence._comment: Posts per 7-day week, per channel. Conservative on purpose — Phase 7 explicitly says start conservative to avoid spam signals. A channel with cadence 0 is prepared but not scheduled.

pillarWeights._comment: Buyer-question-first mix. Relative weight, not a percentage. Prioritize real decision, pricing, alternatives, migration and buyer-education questions over company-centric announcements.

campaignPriorities: Buyer-intent distribution is the primary organic growth motion: favor real decision questions using alternatives, vs, pricing/cost, cheaper/free, worth-it, migration, open-source/self-hosted and small-team/small-business constraints. Each strong question should map to a permanent Miloosh asset when useful.

Use Reddit and other communities as current buyer-intent intelligence. Participate only where a transparent answer is allowed and useful; never drop bare links, manipulate votes, or turn anecdotes into vendor facts. If Reddit writes are blocked by CAPTCHA, continue research without bypassing the block.

Build partnership distribution with agencies, consultants, MSPs, RevOps operators and other advisors who repeatedly influence software selection. Offer neutral data, decision pages and custom research cuts; avoid generic reciprocal-link outreach.
Treat Bing/Microsoft organic discovery as an active secondary search surface. Submit materially changed buyer-intent pages through IndexNow; paid search remains off until an explicit budget decision.

Do not pursue Shopify App Store, Salesforce AppExchange, AppSumo or Chrome Web Store listings unless Miloosh has a real product/integration that belongs there. Chrome Web Store becomes a candidate only for a genuine Miloosh browser extension.

Wix is now an approved, active monetization partner (Impact.com, 4 funnels: Website Builder, Domain, Headless, eCommerce) — prioritize genuinely relevant Wix content where editorially justified: Wix vs Squarespace, Wix vs Shopify, website builder buying advice, Wix Headless for AI-assisted development, domain-selection guides. Never insert the affiliate link directly into a social post — link to the relevant Miloosh page; the page itself resolves the correct funnel.

ElevenLabs is an approved, active monetization partner (PartnerStack) — eligible commercial-content candidate: ElevenLabs alternatives, AI voice/text-to-speech/voice-cloning comparisons, pricing research, use-case guides, ElevenLabs vs competitors. If tagging @elevenlabsio on a platform where that handle is valid, only do so for a genuinely relevant post — never gratuitously, and never implying ElevenLabs endorses Miloosh.
